observed_problem: The fixed-head candidate 705937af2eb45d5ba361fe748d7a622110bcb27c retained a legacy Weekly Grok Trend Sensor generator in the old Weekly spine, but Survey Production Core v2 did not model X/Grok as a first-class Source Intake surface. Weekly therefore had no Core/Profile requirement to perform X intake, Retrospective/Thematic/Foundations had no generic applicability decision or targeted Grok task contract, and no Core authority guaranteed that a returned Grok result was handed back through the configured Google Drive location, imported as exact Raw bytes, and given a Discovery/no-material disposition.
expected_behavior: X/Grok must be a formal Source Intake subflow without adding a third Human Gate. Weekly requires at least one completed X intake run. Retrospective Period and Thematic work explicitly decide REQUIRED/NOT_REQUIRED with substantive ChatGPT rationale; Generative AI Foundations uses the Thematic Profile with a dedicated series Drive category when X is material. ChatGPT defines the run-specific research task and prompt, provisions the exact folder below Google Drive root Grok_X_SourseIntake, reads the returned Markdown, imports exact bytes into repository Raw, and either maps material observations to Discovery or records NO_MATERIAL_DISCOVERY. Grok/X remains Discovery/community-signal input and technical claims require normal authoritative Evidence verification.
actual_behavior: The improvement branch now defines a Profile-aware X Source Intake contract, generic manifest/schema/tooling, common plus Weekly/Special Grok prompt policies, and a canonical Google Drive handoff at Grok_X_SourseIntake/<category>/<edition>/<run-id>/. Weekly is REQUIRED_BY_PROFILE; Period/Thematic are CHATGPT_DECIDES; Foundations may use series_context GENERATIVE_AI_FOUNDATIONS. Discovery Acceptance binds the completed X manifest SHA, validates imported Raw identity, and requires every required run to be linked to Discovery or explicitly closed as no material discovery. The external wait remains incomplete Source Intake rather than a Human/Exception Gate.

provenance.human_review_reference: Owner clarification after fixed-head five-point audit: Weekly and applicable Specials must incorporate X through Grok Source Intake, with results returned through Google Drive Grok_X_SourseIntake

improvement_action: Promoted X/Grok into the Core v2 Source Intake model: added Profile applicability policy, exact run manifest and prompt/instruction authority, Google Drive category/edition/run-folder handoff, exact returned-Raw import/disposition accounting, Discovery Acceptance binding, agent/session guidance, Issue Prevention coverage and dedicated regression tests while preserving the two normal Human Gates.
